verdict.rationale: Every On-Demand Cloud instance comes with a preinstalled JupyterLab server that you open from the Instances page in the console, so the Jupyter half of this either/or story is met in one step. A community user's report of working in Jupyter on a GH200 instance corroborates this. Missing for 10: any documented VS Code/Cursor connection (only plain SSH with console-managed keys is documented), and explicit detail on how one-click the JupyterLab launch is.
